title: Rabbi Avuna the Scribe
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Massekhet Soferim 12:4: Rabbi Yonatan, the scribe of Gufetra, came down here and saw Rabbi Avuna the Scribe reading the Song of the Well and blessing before and after it. Yonatan asked him, “Is this the practice?” He replied, “Until now,” etc.

notes.text: Yonatan is the observer and questioner; Avuna is the reader and the one blessing. The source breaks off after “Until now”; no continuation or ritual ruling is added.
The consulted Soferim text confirms both scribes’ roles and continues beyond Hyman’s excerpt.
